_comment: spec docs/spec/2026-09-03-FollowTestSuite.md §3.6/§4.15, resolution note in that doc's §7. Single source of truth for FollowManager::applyConfig() (C++), mock_server.py's validate_config() (Python), and html/follow-logic.js's validateConfig() (JS). `overrides` is applied on top of `baseline` below. `expectValid` is one shared expectation, enforced identically by all three validators -- the three previously disagreed on ~12 of these ~17 rules (see each case's `note` and the spec's §7 for what used to diverge and how it was fixed) but now share the same rule set.

cases.name: emitHz_zero_fails
cases.note: shared rule -- all three implemented this identically from the start

cases.name: peerTimeoutMs_zero_fails
cases.note: shared rule

cases.name: minSepM_negative_fails
cases.note: shared rule

cases.name: minVSepM_negative_fails
cases.note: shared rule

cases.name: minAltM_negative_fails
cases.note: shared rule

cases.name: maxTargetDistM_zero_fails
cases.note: shared rule

cases.name: minCourseSpeed_negative_fails
cases.note: shared rule

cases.name: geometry_insane_fails
cases.note: Previously mock_server.py's validate_config() had no offsetGeometrySane() equivalent at all, so this passed Python validation while failing C++/JS. Fixed by adding the same minSepM/minVSepM geometry check to validate_config().

cases.name: target_peer_out_of_range_fails
cases.note: Previously only FollowManager::applyConfig() checked targetPeer against NODES_MAX. Fixed by adding the same range check to validate_config() and validateConfig().

cases.name: status_gvar_index_out_of_range_fails
cases.note: Previously follow-logic.js's validateConfig() never range-checked GVAR index fields (-1 or 0-7), only their uniqueness. Fixed by adding the same range check as C++/Python to validateConfig().

cases.name: rc_long_channel_out_of_range_fails
cases.note: Previously follow-logic.js never range-checked RC channel fields (-1 or 1-16), only their uniqueness. Fixed by adding the same range check as C++/Python to validateConfig().

cases.name: max_target_speed_not_greater_than_min_fails
cases.note: Previously follow-logic.js never checked maxTargetSpeedMps > minTargetSpeedMps >= 0 at all. Fixed by adding the same check as C++/Python to validateConfig(). Arm channel must be set here or the check is skipped entirely (see the armed/disarmed cases below).

cases.name: target_speed_zero_defaults_valid_when_disarmed
cases.note: Same as baseline_is_valid -- the compiled-in 0/0 target-speed defaults are only invalid once the pilot arms autothrottle (autothrottleEnableRcChannel != -1); with the arm channel left Disabled (-1, the baseline default) they don't matter at all.

cases.name: target_speed_zero_defaults_fail_when_armed
cases.note: Setting an arm channel means the pilot intends to use autothrottle, so the 0/0 target-speed defaults (an invalid range on their own) must now be explicitly overridden with values sane for this airframe.

cases.name: min_target_speed_zero_fails_when_armed
cases.note: minTargetSpeedMps must be explicitly > 0 when armed, not just left at its 0 default while only maxTargetSpeedMps is edited -- min is the feature's only stall-safety floor.

cases.name: target_speed_explicit_values_valid_when_armed
cases.note: Both values explicitly set for this airframe and the arm channel assigned -- the intended, fully-configured state.

cases.name: speed_correction_accel_negative_fails
cases.note: Previously follow-logic.js never checked speedCorrectionAccelCmS2 >= 0. Fixed by adding the same check as C++/Python to validateConfig().

cases.name: gvar_indices_not_unique_fails
cases.note: Previously JS-only (a raw POST bypassing the UI could set overlapping GVAR indices and the firmware would accept it). Fixed by adding the same uniqueness check to applyConfig() and validate_config().

cases.name: rc_channels_not_unique_fails
cases.note: Previously JS-only. Fixed by adding the same uniqueness check to applyConfig() and validate_config().

cases.name: autothrottle_channel_overlaps_rc_axis_fails
cases.note: Previously JS-only. Fixed by adding the same overlap check to applyConfig() and validate_config().

cases.name: autothrottle_threshold_order_fails
cases.note: Previously JS-only, deliberately not duplicated server-side per mock_server.py's old comment. Fixed by adding the same ordering check to applyConfig() and validate_config().
